arguments.summary: A critical credential compromise incident was detected, originating from external IP 185.220.101.42. The threat actor conducted reconnaissance via port scanning against an internal IT asset (10.0.2.15), followed by lateral movement and successful authentication using compromised credentials. Evidence indicates pass-the-hash exploitation affecting all 23 user accounts within the Finance OU. Despite detection and analysis confirming the breach, attempted credential revocation via IAM/PAM controls was denied due to policy enforcement and lack of direct evidence linking specific accounts to malicious activity in the enforcement phase.

timeline.description: External IP 185.220.101.42 conducted a port scan (ET SCAN Nmap SYN Scan) against internal host 10.0.2.15 (WS-IT-101). Alert logged with low severity.
Successful authentication from 10.0.2.15 to domain controller (10.0.1.1) using CORP\helpdesk credentials. No anomaly detected at time of access.
UEBA system flagged low-risk behavioral indicators for user jdoe; anomaly score 0.35. No immediate action taken.
SIEM correlation identified 23 authentication events linked to source IP 185.220.101.42 and target host 10.0.10.51 in Finance OU. Pattern consistent with pass-the-hash attack.
Sandbox analysis of payload from monitoring phase returned 'clean' verdict for hash e8ff64b8. No malware detected.
Incident escalated to Admin phase. Attempted bulk credential revocation for 23 Finance OU accounts denied due to insufficient direct evidence and policy restrictions on automated deactivation.

rule Suspicious_LSASS_Access {
    meta:
        description = "Detects direct access to LSASS memory, commonly used in credential dumping attacks"
        author = "SOC Team"
        reference = "MITRE ATT&CK T1003.001"
        date = "2026-05-01"
        hash = "e8ff64b8"
    strings:
        $a = "lsass.exe" wide ascii
        $b = { 8B 45 ?? 8B 4D ?? 8B 55 ?? 8B 5D ?? } // Common pattern in reflective DLL injection
        $c = "Secur32.dll" wide ascii
    condition:
        (process.name matches /lsass\.exe/i) or ($a and $b and $c)
}

logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    Image|endswith: '\\rundll32.exe'
    CommandLine|contains: 
      - '%TEMP%'
      - '%AppData%'
  condition: selection
level: high

title: Encoded PowerShell Launched from Office Application
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
  service: sysmon
process_creation:
  - Image|endswith: 'powershell.exe'
    ParentImage|contains:
      - 'winword.exe'
      - 'excel.exe'
      - 'outlook.exe'
    CommandLine|contains: '-encodedcommand'
level: critical
